This is a weird game man

Released date : 2026-09-04

Over the limited period of 21 days, you will tra*n the succubus Luna, progressing through the game while shifting her three stats: “Lust,” “Self-Esteem,” and “Fear.”

As traning accumulates, her lust and fear will rise while her self-esteem is gradually lost. Assemble your own traning plan while managing funds and materials through research, facility upgrades, alchemy, and the screening room.

On the 21st day, the ending branches based on those three stats and the choices you’ve made up to that point. There are even endings reachable under specific conditions…?
